rationale: The assistant immediately identified the likely cause (Auto mode varying power with floor type and dust detection), asked exactly the right first question about power mode, and confirmed it with a safe, proportionate Eco/Boost comparison that matched the hidden truth. It ruled out the only plausible alternative (brush bar wrap) without any disassembly, never invented evidence, and gave sensible conditional escalation criteria rather than sending a working machine back under guarantee. The only minor weakness is some restating of the 'harsh/grinding/pulsing' warning list across turns, which does not impede progress.
